apps.localizedDescription:
BowlingPlus 🎳:

A tweak for Bowling by Jason Belmonte (made for v1.907) that fixes two long-running bugs and adds a fun menu for offline Practice. Works on a normal, non-jailbroken iPhone.

Nothing shows up on screen until you shake your phone. Shake again (or tap outside the menu) to close it.

What's in it:

The Practice-only stuff turns itself off in online matches, tournaments, and the tutorial, so it never messes with other players.

How to use it:

• Shake to open the menu. It's grouped into cards (tap a card's title to fold it). Descriptions are hidden to keep it short: tap the ⓘ at the top to show them all, or tap a row's title to show just that one.

versions.localizedDescription:
Changes:

• Updated pin physics - fixed a friction logic error. Recommended pin friction is now 0.40 (or 0.25 with double physics rate) and is set automatically when you turn on realistic pin physics.

Gamemodes: moved to button underneath custom oil button when selecting an oil pattern. Picking a mode properly restarts the game at frame 1.

• Added obstacle mode: Ramps, barstools, and gates are put on the lane - you must roll over the ramps or avoid the obstacles to score! Choose any combination of the three you want to bowl with in the settings menu before starting a game.

• Hit a barstool or gate and the ball bounces off into the gutter. In the 10th frame, a ramp may slide across the lane.
• Your best game in obstacle mode is saved.
• Replays show the obstacles exactly as they were on that shot.

Recreated the Brunswick barstool.

Real-life oil: turned off for base-game patterns. This would change the way those patterns were oiled, and practicing them offline versus online causes some differences in gameplay. Real-life oil now always applies to custom patterns.

Sidebar menu: added on-screen sidebar to the right side of the screen before throwing a shot.

• Adjust how much loft you want before a throw (the ball lands that far down the lane).
• Show/hide ball stats overlay (toggle).
• Toggle backup ball (hook the ball in the opposite direction while throwing).

• Enable the "swipe in from the right" option to have it auto-hide during bowling. Swipe in from the right to show it, and swipe it back (or tap ») to hide it again.

• Arsenal: sort your balls by name or by stat (power, hook, length, RPM, condition), high to low or low to high.
• Hide ball stats can also be set in the menu (Arsenal section).
• Menu descriptions cleaned up.
